Thanks Marissa — quick first-pass sizing notes below (will expand on the call):

- Based on ~120M tokens/day and 95th pct 40 qps with ~750 token avg, we expect sustained throughput requirements in the ~30–45k tokens/sec range across peak windows.
- For a dedicated deployment, recommended starting configs:
  - Option A: 2x A100-80GB (better for very large batches and long sequences) — expected sustained throughput ~45k tokens/sec, lower latency tail, higher single-request capacity
  - Option B: 4x A10/A30 equivalents (more linear scaling, lower cost per GPU for smaller models) — expected sustained throughput ~30k tokens/sec, more predictable per-request latency at scale
- We’ll propose an autoscale buffer for 30% burst capacity and a hot-standby node for failover to meet your SLOs.

I’ve attached the usage forecast template filled with your numbers (acme_usage_forecast_v1.xlsx) and a short notes doc. On the call we’ll map these to the Redwood pricing tiers and show where dedicated reserved capacity would be cost-effective.
